30A Escapes presents... “All In - Seacrest”, your ultimate Seacrest West retreat where luxury meets laid-back living. The highlight of this property is the outdoor space, featuring a private pool, a spacious fenced-in yard, and plenty of room for sunset dinners or starry-night chats. Just a 3-minute stroll to sugar-white sands with deeded beach access, it’s perfectly located between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach. Explore scenic 30A with loved ones on 8 bikes provided. Learn more below!

★☆ HIGHLIGHTS ☆★

✔ Steps to the Beach: Just a leisurely 3-minute walk to pristine sands and turquoise waters
✔ Private Poolside Oasis: Relax in the spacious fenced backyard with a seasonally heated pool, fire pit, and lounging areas
✔ Designed for Entertaining: Outdoor kitchen with grill, screened-in porch, and plenty of seating for group dinners
✔ Spacious Accommodations: 2634 sq ft including kid-friendly rooms and multiple en-suites
✔ Perfect Location: Situated between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach with easy access to dining, shops, and activities
✔ 8 Bikes Included: Explore scenic 30A with 8 adult beach bikes

Eager to Read More?
Here Are A Few Kind Words from Our Previous Guests:

* “Perfect family vacation home for large groups! The pool and outdoor spaces made our trip truly special.” – Cindy K.
* “Loved the short walk to the beach and spacious backyard. The kitchen was so well-stocked for 15 guests!” – Jack K.
* “Fantastic house with plenty of room for everyone. Best vacation home we’ve stayed in!” – Anna-Lisa H.

★☆ LIVING AREA ☆★

Step into a welcoming open-concept living space designed for comfort and connection. The newly expanded living room is perfect for gathering, with a plush sectional sofa, Smart TV, and French doors that open directly to the backyard oasis.
Enjoy the screened-in porch with outdoor seating and a dining area, perfect for relaxing or sharing meals while surrounded by nature. Meanwhile, the second-floor kids’ den offers a playful retreat with arcade and board games.

✔ Living Room - 1st Floor: A spacious sectional, seamless pool access, and a Smart TV with YouTube TV for family fun.
✔ Screened-In Porch- 1st Floor: Comfortable outdoor seating and a dining area for relaxing or entertaining.
✔ Kids’ Den - 2nd Floor: A game table, arcade games, board games, puzzles, and cards, along with access to a private deck.

★☆ KITCHEN AND DINING ☆★

Create memorable meals in the fully renovated kitchen featuring granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and an oversized island with barstool seating. With room for everyone, the dining area offers two large tables, accommodating up to 12 guests in total.

✔ Chef’s Kitchen: Fully equipped with cookware, crockpot, blender, and both a drip coffee maker + Keurig
✔ Ample Dining: Two dining tables with seating for 10, plus kitchen island for 4 and more - perfect for large groups
✔ Outdoor Dining Options: Screened-in porch with dining for 6 and 2 picnic tables accommodating 12 more by the outdoor kitchen

★☆ OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ☆★

Your dream backyard awaits! The center of attention is the private seasonally heated pool, surrounded by loungers, picnic tables, and two shaded umbrellas. End evenings under the stars, sharing laughs around the fire pit or grilling fresh seafood on the propane BBQ.

✔ Private Pool: Perfect for relaxation year-round, seasonally heated between September and April
✔ Dining Al Fresco: Outdoor kitchen with built-in grill and alfresco dining options for all the crew
✔ Outdoor Entertaining: Wood-burning Fire Pit with outdoor seating
✔ Fenced-In Yard: Ideal for both fun and privacy

★☆ BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ☆★

1st Floor:
King Guest Bedroom: King bed with Smart TV and a full bathroom featuring a tub/shower combo
Queen Guest Bedroom: Queen bed + Twin Daybed (Sleeps 3) with a full en-suite bathroom featuring a glass-enclosed shower

2nd Floor:
Primary Suite: King bed with reading nook and a full private en-suite featuring a rain shower
Queen Guest Bedroom: Queen bed with Smart TV and a full en-suite bathroom featuring a glass-enclosed shower
Bunk Room: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds (Sleeps 4)
Twin Bedroom: 2 Twin Beds
Shared Bathroom: Full bathroom with double vanity (shared with Twin Bedroom and Bunk Room)
Kids' Den (Common Area): Optional sleeping area with 2 Twin Beds

★☆ LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ☆★

Nestled between the charming neighborhoods of Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, All In - Seacrest perfectly captures the laid-back coastal lifestyle. This home offers easy access to the best of 30A, all within walking or a short driving distance. Here's what’s nearby:

✔ Deeded Beach Access (3-minute walk): Within easy walking distance to the deeded beach access point, All In - Seacrest puts you at the heart of 30A’s charm, making it the perfect base for your coastal getaway.
✔ The Big Chill (4-minute drive): A vibrant hub featuring world-class entertainment, live music, movies on a jumbo screen, family-friendly fun, and coastal shops. With its diverse dining options and lively atmosphere, it’s the perfect spot to relax and soak in local vibes.
✔ Alys Beach (5-minute bike ride): Stunning architecture, scenic pathways, and a serene atmosphere make this a must-visit destination for anyone seeking beauty and tranquility.
✔ Rosemary Beach (5-minute drive): A picturesque storybook town known for its cobblestone streets, upscale dining, boutique shopping, and a laid-back, coastal charm ideal for a leisurely afternoon.
✔ Publix Supermarket (6-minute drive): Conveniently located for all your grocery needs, from fresh ingredients to snacks, ensuring your stay is as easy as it is enjoyable.

★☆ OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ☆★

✔ To ensure a smooth and secure stay, guests are required to complete the 30A Escapes Rental Agreement after booking. This agreement outlines important house rules and helps us provide the best experience possible. Once your reservation is confirmed, you will receive a link via the booking platform to sign the agreement. After it is completed, we will send your official booking confirmation email with all the details you need. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us directly – we are always happy to help!
✔ Travel insurance is NOT included in your quote. It can be purchased upon booking, added to your reservation by the final payment date, or obtained independently.
✔ We do NOT accept wire transfers for payment. (AMEX, Visa, and MasterCard ONLY)
✔ This property has 8 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.
✔ LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach.
✔ Pool can only be heated between September 1st and April 30th.
✔ There is an active Ring doorbell camera at the front door of the home.
✔ Please note this property does not have cable television - YouTube TV only

☆★ YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ☆★

At 30A Escapes, we are committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.

★☆ BOOK TODAY AND START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ☆★
